items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025
items.q: We could never get Phil Woods to come forward enough. We let him wear his hat as a crown but —

ctx.x: It’s interesting you said that about sort of corralling the musicians and said, “Okay after this number then you have to go over here.” And I had that experience doing a show with a singer, a Billie Holiday show, and you know she would say, “After this thing you say this and then I’ll say this.” And I was going, “What do you mean?” It’s theater.
Yes. We could never get Phil Woods to come forward enough. We let him wear his hat as a crown but —
I’ll be darned. Well you are just — have accomplished so much in your lifetime and — you still have projects going on for the future?
